requirements.text: Students should be able to customize their timetable view with features such as color-coding modules, hiding canceled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
The personalised timetable management features must integrate seamlessly into the existing interface without requiring additional installations.
The system should provide students with flexible notification options (email, SMS, or in-app alerts) for new grades, assignment deadlines, and exam dates.
The notification system must be reliable and timely.
A simple feedback form should be implemented within the portal, allowing students to provide anonymous feedback on content quality, delivery, and resources after the teaching period.
The feedback collection process must maintain student anonymity to encourage honest opinions.
The feedback management system should be designed to avoid complicating the process for module coordinators and administrators.
The feedback submission process should be straightforward and not overwhelming for students.
